measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

applications.name: LibreChat
applications.client: @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.115.0 through @langchain/anthropic 1.5.2 and @librechat/agents 4.0.1 (messages.create, streamed for a turn), with anthropic-beta default headers it appends per model; the model list by axios with x-api-key

backend.call: a conversation turn: POST /v1/messages streamed, system and messages with images and documents, tools, thinking (enabled with budget_tokens, or adaptive with display), prompt caching (cache_control ephemeral, with its TTL)

anthropic-beta values appended to the same request (max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15; token-efficient-tools-2025-02-19,output-128k-2025-02-19; fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14; web-search-2025-03-05)
a conversation's title: the same client, POST /v1/messages
the Anthropic endpoint's models at startup, when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set and ANTHROPIC_MODELS is not: GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models with x-api-key and anthropic-version, reading data[].id

applications.name: Volter Harness
applications.client: Claude Code as a harness runtime: its key is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (x-api-key), or a worker route with `provider: anthropic` gives it ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (Authorization: Bearer); Claude Code sends through its SDK's beta namespace (?beta=true), measured with claude 2.1.286

backend.call: Claude Code's turns: POST /v1/messages?beta=true streamed, with tools, thinking, cache_control and its anthropic-beta list
Claude Code's token counts: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens?beta=true (the relay endpoint answers the same calls when Claude Code is pointed at it)

applications.name: RH2
applications.note: no Claude API call: its Model keys page points Claude Code at RH2 itself, and its valve forwards to Open Autonomy

applications.name: Open Autonomy
applications.note: no Claude API call: /v1/messages is forwarded to Merge's gateway (packages/backend/src/proxy.ts:8)

applications.name: Substrate
applications.note: no Claude API call (its valve forwards to Open Autonomy)

applications.name: Workbench
applications.note: no call in the clone: its Flowise program lists the anthropic twin, but Flowise's calls are in Flowise's npm package, not in Workbench

applications.name: Volter Browsers
applications.note: no Claude API call in the running product (scripts/agent.ts is a dev script against the substrate's endpoint)

applications.name: localrouter
applications.note: no Claude API call: it answers the Messages API itself; @anthropic-ai/sdk is its probes' client of itself

applications.name: Twin
applications.note: no Claude API call (it names the vendor it twins)

applications.name: Volter Editor
applications.note: no Claude API call: Claude Code is pointed at OpenRouter

applications.name: Postiz
applications.note: no Claude API call found (a CI workflow names Anthropic)

applications.client: @ai-sdk/anthropic ^4.0.63 (POST {baseURL}/messages with x-api-key and anthropic-version 2023-06-01; stream: true for streamText; Output.object as output_config.format json_schema)

backend.call: generateText with Output.object: POST /v1/messages, not streamed, a structured answer (program admin with claude-sonnet-4-6; partner invite email and lander with claude-opus-4-8)
streamText with Output.object: POST /v1/messages streamed, a structured answer (AI filters, CSV mapping, rewards with claude-sonnet-4-6)
streamText: POST /v1/messages streamed (support chat with claude-sonnet-4-6 and its tools; AI completion with the caller's model)

applications.name: dubinc/dub
applications.gate: AI completion and CSV mapping call Anthropic directly; no feature switch (apps/web/app/api/ai/completion/route.ts:30-31; apps/web/lib/ai/generate-csv-mapping.ts:16).

applications.client: @ai-sdk/anthropic ^4.0.49 through createAnthropic (POST {baseURL}/messages with x-api-key and anthropic-version 2023-06-01)

backend.call: the workspace's AI agents and chat: streamText with tools (tool_use and tool_result turns), POST /v1/messages streamed
usage read for billing, cache-creation and cache-read tokens included

applications.name: twentyhq/twenty
applications.gate: The built-in catalog contains OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI and Mistral; default tiers try them in that order according to available credentials, with no disabled models. This is automatic credential resolution, not an operator provider switch (packages/twenty-server/src/engine/metadata-modules/ai/ai-models/services/default-ai-catalog.service.ts:19-37; services/provider-config.service.ts:28-41; utils/load-default-model-preferences.util.ts:14-19,58).
